mechanism: Ciprofloxacin may inhibit CYP3A4, potentially increasing sacubitril exposure and active metabolite (sacubitrilat) levels, while sacubitril's vasodilatory effects combined with fluoroquinolone-associated QT prolongation and hypotension pose additive cardiac and hemodynamic risks.
action: Monitor blood pressure and renal function closely; consider alternative antibiotic if fluoroquinolone is not essential; baseline and periodic ECG monitoring recommended during concurrent use.
